direction.refusal: the site cannot publish a list in the direction "{value}": a list is ascending or descending

offset.refusal: the site cannot publish a list that skips {value} posts: a list skips none, or a whole number of them

number.refusal: the site cannot publish a list of {value} posts: a list shows 1 to 100 posts

name.refusal: the site declares no form "{value}"; it declares {declared}

target.refusal: a link that opens anywhere but a new tab (target "{value}")

rel.refusal: a link with the rel value "{value}"; a link's rel may hold {words}, each once

embeds.refusal: the site cannot embed content from {host}; it embeds content from {services}

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from YouTube; use the address of a video or a playlist, such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…, with no parameter but a start time (t)
youtube.allow: accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share

vimeo.name: Vimeo
vimeo.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Vimeo; use the address of a video, such as https://vimeo.com/…
vimeo.allow: autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; web-share

screen9.name: Screen9
screen9.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Screen9; use the address in the video's embed code, such as https://qcnl.tv/e/…

loom.name: Loom
loom.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Loom; use the address of a video, such as https://www.loom.com/share/…

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Spotify; use the address of a track, an episode, a show, an album, a playlist or an artist, such as https://open.spotify.com/track/…

acast.name: Acast
acast.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Acast; use the address of an episode, such as https://shows.acast.com/…/episodes/…

apple-podcasts.name: Apple Podcasts
apple-podcasts.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Apple Podcasts; use the address of a show or an episode, such as https://podcasts.apple.com/…/podcast/…/id…

speaker-deck.name: Speaker Deck
speaker-deck.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Speaker Deck; use the address in the presentation's embed code, such as https://speakerdeck.com/player/…

datawrapper.name: Datawrapper
datawrapper.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from Datawrapper; use the address of a published chart, such as https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/…/

codepen.name: CodePen
codepen.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from CodePen; use the address of a pen, such as https://codepen.io/…/pen/…

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.refusal: the site cannot embed this address from LinkedIn; use the address of a public post, such as https://www.linkedin.com/posts/…

refusals.element-not-taken: this kind of post cannot hold {element}; take it out, or ask the site's developer to allow it
refusals.inline-element: the site cannot publish {inline} in {element}; take it out
refusals.soft-break: the site cannot keep a line break made by a plain new line; join the lines, or make it a line break of its own
refusals.raw-html: the site cannot publish the raw HTML {tag}; use the editor's own formats
refusals.raw-unclosed: the raw HTML <{tag}> is never closed; close it, or use the editor's own formats
refusals.construct: the site cannot publish this: Markdown calls it {type}; take it out

constructs.thematicBreak: the site cannot publish a separator; take it out
constructs.linkReference: the site cannot publish a link that names its address elsewhere; write it as [text](address)
constructs.imageReference: the site cannot publish an image that names its address elsewhere; add the image again
constructs.definition: the site cannot publish a link definition; write the address in the link itself

refusals.heading-level: the site cannot publish a heading at level {level}: the post's title is its level 1; use a level from {levels}
refusals.heading-empty: the site cannot publish a heading without text; write its text, or take it out
refusals.anchor-form: the site cannot publish the anchor "{anchor}": an anchor holds only a to z, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusals.anchor-place: an anchor stands first in a heading; move it there, or take it out
refusals.anchor-twice: block {block} has the anchor "{anchor}" too, and a link to it would land on the first; give each heading its own
refusals.anchor-taken: the site keeps the anchor "{anchor}" for its footnotes; give the heading another
refusals.list-start: the site cannot publish a numbered list that starts at {start}; start it at 1
refusals.list-loose: the site cannot publish a list with blank lines between its items; take the blank lines out
refusals.list-task: the site cannot publish a task list; write its items as plain text
refusals.list-item-empty: the site cannot publish a list item without text; write its text, or take it out
refusals.list-item-blocks: a list item holds one paragraph, and a list under it at most; move the rest out of the list
refusals.quote-empty: the site cannot publish a quote without text; write its text, or take it out
refusals.quote-block: a quote cannot hold {block}; move it out of the quote
refusals.citation-place: a citation is a quote's last paragraph, wrapped whole in <cite>; move it there, or take it out
refusals.code-empty: the site cannot publish an empty code block; write its code, or take it out
refusals.code-language: the site shows a code block without a language, so "{language}" is left out
refusals.table-row: row {row} of the table has {cells} cells and its header {columns}; give every row the header's number of cells
refusals.table-no-header: the site cannot publish a table without a header row; give it one
refusals.table-header-rows: the site cannot publish a table with more than one header row; make the others plain rows
refusals.table-header-plain: a table's header row holds header cells alone; make each cell in it a header cell
refusals.table-header-outside: a header cell stands in a table's header row alone; make the others plain cells
refusals.table-empty: the site cannot publish an empty table; give it its cells, or take it out
refusals.table-spans: row {row} of the table does not cover each of its columns once; check the merged cells
refusals.table-align: column {column} of the table is aligned differently in different rows; align the whole column alike
refusals.table-shape: the site cannot publish this table's HTML{tag}: it reads only a caption, a header, a body and a footer, with the formats bold, italic, link, superscript, subscript, code and strikethrough
refusals.table-cell-attribute: the site cannot publish the table cell {tag}: a cell takes colspan, rowspan and a text-align of left, center or right
refusals.link-title: the site cannot publish a link with a title; take the title out
refusals.link-address: the site cannot link to {address}: a link leads to a path on the site, or to {schemes}
refusals.link-fragment: the site cannot link to {address} alone; link to the post and the anchor, as a path on the site
refusals.link-admin: the site cannot link to {address}, the host where editors sign in, which visitors never reach
refusals.image-alone: an image stands alone in its paragraph, with its caption after a line break; move the rest out
refusals.image-place: an image stands at the top of the body, never in a quote or a list; move it out
refusals.image-alt: the site cannot publish an image without alt text; describe the image
refusals.image-alt-lines: an image's alt text is one line; join its lines
refusals.image-title: the site cannot publish an image with a title; take the title out, or make it the caption
refusals.embed-place: an embed stands at the top of the body, never in a quote or a list; move it out
refusals.embed-caption: the site cannot show a caption with the embed {address}; take the caption out
refusals.directive-unknown: the site has no directive {name}; choose one it offers, or write the colons as \:
refusals.directive-form: the site writes the directive {name} as {form}
refusals.directive-label: the site cannot publish the directive {name} with a label; take it out
refusals.directive-attribute: the directive {name} takes no setting "{attribute}"; take it out
refusals.directive-value: the site cannot publish the setting "{attribute}" with the value "{value}"; choose another
refusals.footnote-twice: the footnote "{label}" is marked twice; give each mark a footnote of its own
refusals.footnote-unmarked: the footnote "{label}" has no mark in the text; mark it, or take it out
refusals.footnote-empty: the footnote "{label}" has no text; write its text, or take out the footnote and its mark
refusals.footnote-blocks: the footnote "{label}" holds more than one paragraph of text; make it one
refusals.footnote-place: a footnote's mark cannot stand in a link's text; move it out of the link
refusals.read-back: the site would read {element} otherwise than it is written, whatever is escaped; reword what looks like Markdown in it
refusals.source-frontmatter: the file does not start with its fields between two lines of ---; save the post again from the editing tool
refusals.source-yaml: the fields at the top of the file cannot be read ({detail}); save the post again from the editing tool
refusals.source-json: the file cannot be read as JSON ({detail}); save it again from the editing tool
refusals.status: a post is a draft, scheduled or published, not "{status}"; choose one
refusals.scheduled-date: a scheduled post needs its date and time; give it one, or make it a draft
refusals.language-folder: the folder {folder} is none of the site's languages, so the post cannot be published; move it to a language the site declares
refusals.admin-file: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may change {file}, so visitors still get the last version an Admin left; ask an Admin to save it
refusals.admin-legal: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may change a post chosen as a legal page, so visitors still see its last version; ask an Admin to save it
refusals.admin-legal-gone: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may take a post chosen as a legal page off the site, so visitors still see it; ask an Admin to restore it, or to choose another page in the settings
refusals.title-empty: the site cannot publish a post without a title; give it one
refusals.title-markup: the site cannot publish a title holding HTML; write it as plain text
refusals.slug: the site cannot use "{slug}" as a slug: a slug holds a to z in lowercase, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusals.slug-empty: the site cannot make a slug of this title; give the post a slug of a to z, digits and hyphens
refusals.field-required: the site cannot publish a post without its {field}; fill it in
refusals.field-moment: the site cannot publish "{value}" as a date and time in {field}; choose one
refusals.field-text: the site cannot publish this as {field}; write it as plain text
refusals.field-markup: the site cannot publish {field} holding HTML; write it as plain text
refusals.image-required: the site cannot publish a post without its featured image; choose one, or keep the post as a draft
refusals.image-gone: the original of the image {name} is gone from the media library; upload it again, or choose another
refusals.image-outside: the site shows images from its media library, not {address}; upload the image, and choose it there
refusals.image-small: this image is {width} pixels wide, and the site takes none narrower than {smallest}; choose a larger one
refusals.image-narrow: the image {name} is {width} pixels wide, narrower than the {display} the site usually shows images at, so it may look soft
refusals.image-moving: the site cannot show a moving image; choose a still JPEG, PNG or WebP, or a video
refusals.image-kind: the site cannot use {kind} as an image; save it as a JPEG, PNG or WebP, and upload that
refusals.image-large: this image is larger than the 30 MB the site takes; save it smaller, and upload it again
refusals.image-pointer: the file holds a pointer to the image rather than the image, so the build could not fetch it; save the post again, or tell whoever runs the site
refusals.icon-square: the site icon must be square; choose a square image
refusals.icon-small: the site icon is {width} pixels wide, and must be at least 512, or an SVG; choose a larger one
refusals.svg: the site cannot show this SVG, which holds {what}; save it without that, and upload it again
refusals.seo-shape: the site cannot read the search and sharing fields; save the post again from the editing tool
refusals.seo-flag: the search and sharing field {key} is on or off; turn it on, or leave it out
refusals.seo-text: the search and sharing field {key} is plain text; fill it in, or leave it out
refusals.seo-schema: the site cannot use "{value}" as a structured data type; choose one of {types}
refusals.seo-image-alt: a sharing image comes with its alt text, and alt text with its image; fill in both, or neither
refusals.other-shape: the site cannot read the other addresses; save the post again from the editing tool
refusals.other-address: the site cannot use "{address}" as an other address: it is a path as a browser sends it, starting with a slash
refusals.other-answer: the other address {address} cannot answer "{answer}": it answers 301, 302, 307, 308 or show
refusals.other-show-query: the site cannot show a post at {address}: a post is shown at a path without a query; answer with a redirect, or take the query out
refusals.other-no-address: {plural} have no page of their own, so they take no other addresses; take them out
refusals.other-held: the address {address} belongs to "{holder}"; choose another
refusals.other-rule: the site's redirect rules hold the address {address}; choose another, or ask an Admin to remove the rule
refusals.term-main: the term "{term}" has no file in the main language, {language}; save it there first
refusals.term-name: the term {term} has no name; give it one
refusals.term-markup: the site cannot publish the term "{term}", whose name or description holds HTML; write them as plain text
refusals.term-slug: the site cannot use "{slug}" as the slug of the term "{term}": a slug holds a to z in lowercase, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusals.term-language: the term "{term}" has a file in the folder {folder}, which is none of the site's languages; remove it
refusals.term-differs: the term "{term}" has another description or parent in {language} than in the main language; a term's are the same in every language
refusals.term-parent: the parent of the term "{term}" is gone ({parent}); choose another
refusals.term-loop: the term "{term}" stands under itself; choose another parent
refusals.term-gone: the post names a term of its {plural} that no longer exists ({id}); choose another
refusals.term-translation: the term "{term}" has no name in {language}, so it shows the main language's
refusals.list-term-gone: a post list names a {taxonomy} that no longer exists ({term}), so it is left out of the list
refusals.reference-no-address: a reference leads to "{title}", and {plural} have no page of their own; choose another
refusals.reference-term: a reference leads to the term "{term}", and {plural} have no page of their own; choose another
refusals.link-gone: the site shows "{text}" without its link, since what it leads to no longer exists
refusals.link-no-page: the site shows "{text}" without its link until "{title}" is published
refusals.link-language: the link "{text}" leads to another language, though its target has a translation in this post's
refusals.parent-missing: the post's parent no longer exists ({parent}); choose another
refusals.parent-type: the post's parent "{parent}" is not one of its {plural}; choose another
refusals.parent-loop: the post stands under itself, through "{parent}"; choose another parent
refusals.parent-refused: the post's parent "{parent}" cannot be published, and its address depends on it; fix the parent first
refusals.address-held: the address {address} belongs to "{holder}"; change this post's slug or parent
refusals.address-reserved: the site keeps the address {address} for itself; change this post's slug
refusals.address-feed: the address {address} is {feed}; change this post's slug
refusals.address-search: the address {address} is the site's search page; change this post's slug
refusals.address-list: the address {address} is among the later pages of the list in "{holder}"; change this post's slug
refusals.address-term: the address {address} is the page of the term "{term}"; change this post's slug
refusals.set-twice: "{holder}" is this post's translation in the same language; a language holds one post of a set
refusals.not-found-none: the post chosen for addresses not found cannot serve, so the site shows its plain text there; publish it, or choose another
refusals.setting-pattern: the site cannot use the line "{line}" as a pattern; correct it
refusals.setting-shape: the site cannot read this value; save the settings again from the editing tool
refusals.setting-required: the site needs this setting; fill it in
refusals.setting-no-page: the setting {setting} leads to "{title}", which has no page now, so it is left out until it does
refusals.setting-translation: the setting leads to "{title}", which has no translation in {language}, so it leads to the chosen post
refusals.menu-shape: the site cannot read this entry; save the menu again from the editing tool
refusals.menu-no-page: the menu leaves out "{title}" and the entries under it, since it has no page now; it comes back by itself
refusals.menu-url: the site cannot lead a menu to "{url}": an entry leads to a post, a path on the site, or http://, https://, mailto: or tel:
refusals.menu-title: the entry has no label; give it one, or choose a post
refusals.menu-nowhere: the entry "{title}" leads nowhere and holds nothing; give it an address, or take it out
refusals.rule-shape: the site cannot read this rule; save the rules again from the Redirects page
refusals.rule-pattern-post: the pattern {pattern} cannot lead to a post by ID; give it an address as its target
refusals.rule-pattern-long: a pattern holds at most {most} characters; shorten it
refusals.rule-twice: another rule has the source {source}; remove one of them
refusals.rule-patterns: the site takes at most {most} patterns; remove some
refusals.rule-source: the site cannot use "{source}" as a source: it is a path as a browser sends it, starting with a slash
refusals.rule-reserved: the site keeps the address {source} for itself; a rule cannot answer there
refusals.rule-parameters: the source {source} holds more than {most} query parameters; shorten it
refusals.rule-status: the rule from {source} cannot answer "{status}": it answers {statuses}
refusals.rule-target: the rule from {source} cannot answer so: {reason}
refusals.rule-loop: the rule from {source} leads back to itself, so it would never answer; change its target
refusals.rule-chain: the rule from {source} leads to another rule, so a visitor is sent on twice; point it straight at the end
refusals.rule-start: the rule from {source} leads to the start page, which search engines may read as a page that is gone
refusals.rule-post-off: the rule from {source} leads to what has no page now, so it does not answer until that is published
refusals.rule-shadowed: the rule from {source} does not answer, since a post or a term's page is live at that address
refusals.legal-missing: the site asks for consent, and has no {page} to link to; choose one among the legal pages
refusals.publisher-missing: the site has no publisher's name, so the footer shows none of its details; give it one, or a title for the site
